{
"meetingId": "268",
"tickets": [
{
"templateId": null,
"title": "Provide charitable funding source comparison",
"text": "Provide a comparison of charitable funding sources for Jasper Lanternmoss, evaluating appreciated Moonbadger Systems shares, cash from his Velvet Acorn Custody taxable account, and a donor‑advised fund, including impacts on portfolio concentration and estimated taxable gains avoided, by 2026‑08‑06.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2026-08-06",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "For the charitable funding source comparison, Jasper asked about donating appreciated Moonbadger Systems shares, donating cash from the taxable account, and using a donor‑advised fund, including effects on portfolio concentration and estimated taxable gains avoided; the agreed follow-up is due 2026-08-06."
},
{
"templateId": null,
"title": "Obtain Pocket Lantern Youth Lab delivery instructions",
"text": "Obtain the full delivery instructions, legal name, tax identification number, and gift‑acceptance contact for Pocket Lantern Youth Lab on behalf of Jasper Lanternmoss, needed to move securities cleanly, by 2026‑08‑13.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2026-08-13",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "For Pocket Lantern Youth Lab transfer instructions, the nonprofit provided only a general development-office email and a brokerage name, and Jasper has not received the full delivery instructions, legal name, tax identification confirmation, or gift‑acceptance contact needed to move securities cleanly; follow-up is needed for 2026-08-13."
},
{
"templateId": null,
"title": "Resolve donor‑advised fund registration mismatch",
"text": "Resolve the registration mismatch between the donor‑advised fund paperwork listing Jasper Lanternmoss individually and the jointly‑titled Velvet Acorn Custody taxable account with Lena Lanternmoss, determining required authorizations, by 2026‑08‑12.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2026-08-12",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "For the account registration mismatch for securities delivery, the draft donor-advised fund paperwork lists Jasper individually while the Velvet Acorn Custody taxable account is titled jointly with Lena, creating uncertainty about required authorization and acknowledgement naming; follow-up is needed for 2026-08-12."
},
{
"templateId": null,
"title": "Confirm current securities delivery instructions",
"text": "Confirm the current delivery instructions and donor notification steps for the next securities gift from Jasper Lanternmoss’s Velvet Acorn Custody taxable account to the charity, ensuring the process improves on the prior three‑week experience, by 2026‑08‑16.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2026-08-16",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "For the prior donation transfer service experience, Jasper reported that a prior securities gift through Velvet Acorn Custody took nearly three weeks and the charity initially could not identify the donor, so the agreed follow‑up due 2026-08-16 is to confirm current delivery instructions and notification steps before initiating another gift."
},
{
"templateId": null,
"title": "Identify Moonbadger Systems tax lots",
"text": "Identify the specific high‑gain and recent reinvestment Moonbadger Systems tax lots to be donated by Jasper Lanternmoss before preparing the transfer request, by 2026‑08‑09.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2026-08-09",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "Mira’s review found that the Moonbadger Systems position includes several high-gain lots and a few recent reinvestment lots, so the agreed tax-lot follow-up due 2026-08-09 is to identify the specific shares selected for donation before any transfer request is prepared."
},
{
"templateId": null,
"title": "Determine grant timing for gifts",
"text": "Determine the timing for the initial Pocket Lantern Youth Lab gift and the schedule for later grants to food security and arts organizations for Jasper Lanternmoss, with a decision by 2026‑08‑20.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2026-08-20",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "The colleague memorial appeal changed Jasper’s preferred timing because he wants an initial gift to Pocket Lantern Youth Lab before the family’s campaign update, while leaving flexibility for later grants to the food security and arts organizations; the agreed grant-timing follow-up is due 2026-08-20."
},
{
"templateId": null,
"title": "Assemble documentation packet for non‑cash gifts",
"text": "Assemble the documentation packet—including nonprofit receipt requirements, account transfer confirmations, and year‑end reporting files—for Jasper Lanternmoss’s non‑cash charitable gifts, to meet Rowan Copperwisp’s request for contemporaneous acknowledgements, by 2026‑12‑15.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2026-12-15",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "Jasper said Rowan wants contemporaneous acknowledgements and valuation support for any noncash charitable gift, and the household has not yet assembled the nonprofit receipt requirements, account transfer confirmations, and year-end reporting file; follow-up on the documentation packet is needed for 2026-12-15."
}
]
}
